0.long_answer: The VPS33B gene, which when mutated causes the autosomal recessive arthrogryposis–renal dysfunction and cholestasis (ARC) syndrome, is located on human chromosome 15. More precisely, genetic mapping studies have identified its position in the 15q26 region (with some sources further specifying the sub-band as 15q26.1). This localization aids in understanding the genetic basis of the syndrome and supports targeted diagnostic and research efforts.
